summary: The Marlee Avenue corridor is currently facing an unprecedented onslaught of applications for new multi-residential buildings and a significant increase in development intensification. This new housing is desperately needed for the City of Toronto but it comes in the wake of the draconian Bill 23 in which the Province of Ontario radically reduced municipal powers and planning tools to manage growth in a comprehensive manner. The Marlee Avenue corridor is already experiencing the crush of overwhelming traffic (including the Allen Road); and a significant dearth of community and social infrastructure such as a community centre, library, daycares and other local government services. The Glencairn Subway Station Planning Study will identify these desperately needed improvements to ensure that this emerging, newly transformed community will be complete, inclusive and sustainable for its residents into the future. The Glencairn Subway Station Planning Study has an opportunity to incorporate all of these elements in a cross-departmental and multi-disciplinary way including from among the following previous Council approved motions. decided: City Council on December 13, 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, to issue the Request for Proposal for the Glencairn Subway Station Planning Study within the first quarter of 2024, such study to: a. include the identification of future social and community infrastructure that is needed within the study area to accommodate future growth; and b. investigate any traffic and transportation improvements in the Marlee and Lawrence Avenue West corridor as identified in item 2022.IE27.14 - Urgent Need to Support Comprehensive Transportation Study to Address the Hyper Gridlock and the Related Traffic Safety Issues at Lawrence Avenue West, Marlee Avenue, and the Allen Road.

City Council on December 13, 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, to issue the Request for Proposal for the Glencairn Subway Station Planning Study within the first quarter of 2024, such study to: a. include the identification of future social and community infrastructure that is needed within the study area to accommodate future growth; and b. investigate any traffic and transportation improvements in the Marlee and Lawrence Avenue West corridor as identified in item 2022.IE27.14 - Urgent Need to Support Comprehensive Transportation Study to Address the Hyper Gridlock and the Related Traffic Safety Issues at Lawrence Avenue West, Marlee Avenue, and the Allen Road.
